title: The installers ship a pinned LaTeX engine so a paper compiles to PDF without a TeX installation
user_story: As the owner I want the paper step to produce a PDF on a computer without TeX Live or MiKTeX, instead of only reporting that compilation is unavailable (live run 2026-10-28; agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md A6).

requirements.description: The Windows installer and the .deb carry Tectonic 0.17.0 from its GitHub release, pinned by SHA-256; a mismatching download is deleted and the build fails; only the binary and its MIT licence are installed, in <install>/tools.
backend.paper.latex searches <install>/tools (or PHDLAB_TOOLS_DIR) before other TeX folders, so the bundled engine is available without PATH changes.
When Tectonic cannot download packages on its first compile, the report says to connect to the internet once; a LaTeX error is not blamed on the network.
The installer smoke tests (CI) require the installed engine to run `--version` 0.17.0 and to be removed on uninstall.

nonfunctional: No download or execution of Tectonic in unit tests
Installer growth: about 51 MB (Windows) and 25 MB (Linux)
preconditions: Network access when building the installers
postconditions: An installed copy can compile LaTeX to PDF after one online first compile
acceptance_criteria: CI installer jobs build both installers with the real pinned downloads and run the bundled engine

scenarios.expected: Both pins are 0.17.0 GitHub release assets with SHA-256; both builds stage tools/
Only the binary and the licence are staged from a matching zip or tar.gz
A wrong SHA-256 deletes the download and fails; an archive without the binary fails
With PATH empty the bundled engine is found and listed; the default folder is <install>/tools
A network failure gives the connect-once note; a LaTeX error does not
A missing engine or a binary that is not Tectonic 0.17.0 fails the smoke check

recovery: Fix at build_installers/latex; never unpin, skip the SHA-256 check or fall back to an unverified download. TASK-LATEX-BUNDLE-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Local stand-in archives and binaries in a temporary folder; the real assets are downloaded and run only by the CI installer jobs. Evidence in docs/qa/evidence/latex-bundle-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 6 tests on 1099a52, all 6 failing (no pins, no staging, no bundled folder, no offline note, no smoke check). GREEN: 6/6.
